event_name: AI Diffusion Rule IFR — Effective Date
regulation: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion, 15 CFR Parts 734, 740, 742, 744
impact_assessment: Three-tier country framework for AI model weight exports; new authorization requirements for Tier 2 countries; Tier 3 (China, Russia) policy of denial. Creates deemed-export surface for API access by foreign nationals.
industry_response: Major AI labs implementing tiered access controls; Legal challenge by Anthropic (filed Mar 2026)
notes: Most significant AI export control rule to date; creates new ECCN categories for AI model weights

regulation: BIS Affiliates Rule amending 15 CFR Part 744
impact_assessment: 50% aggregate ownership test for Entity List affiliate restrictions; snap-back date 10 November 2026. Affects all US companies with ownership stakes in Chinese-affiliated entities.
industry_response: Compliance reviews of corporate ownership structures; divestiture of minority stakes in affected entities
notes: Snap-back date: 10 November 2026 — controls revert to pre-rule state if not made permanent by that date

regulation: China Unreliable Entity List Regulations (2020); Rare Earth Export Controls (2023 amendments)
impact_assessment: 56 US defence and semiconductor companies added to China's Unreliable Entity List; export licence denial for rare earths and critical minerals. Creates supply chain vulnerability for US semiconductor industry.
industry_response: US industry seeking rare earth alternatives; Congressional hearings on critical mineral supply chains
notes: Bidirectional nature of export controls — China's retaliatory measures demonstrate mutual leverage

impact_assessment: Largest BIS civil penalty for semiconductor equipment to China. Establishes enforcement precedent for third-country transshipment through intermediaries.
industry_response: Industry-wide compliance review of distributor and reseller agreements
notes: Shipments routed through intermediaries in third countries — transshipment enforcement

regulation: IEEPA Emergency Order (Executive Order under 50 U.S.C. ch. 35)
impact_assessment: Normalizes cyber-predicate enforcement: AI-enabled cyberattack triggers export control measures against underlying AI capability. Predicated on July 2026 agentic incidents.
industry_response: Industry opposition; Anthropic legal challenge filed Mar 2026; technology sector coalition letter
notes: Subject of Anthropic v. DoD, N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-01996; constitutionality challenged on First Amendment and due process grounds

impact_assessment: If BIS Affiliates Rule not made permanent by 10 November 2026, affiliate restrictions revert to pre-rule state. Creates regulatory cliff for companies that restructured based on the rule.
industry_response: Industry lobbying for permanent rule; uncertainty in compliance planning
notes: CRITICAL DATE — monitor for BIS rulemaking activity to make rule permanent before snap-back
